changes: VAR overlays: badge (circle + free text) and logo, positioned together on one live preview of the comp — drag to place, drag the handle to resize, hold Shift to drag straight, and overlays snap to each other's centre line for matching heights
Per-variation control: each variant can have its own badge text, and badge or logo can be switched off for individual variants
Attach to layer is now a list of real layer names instead of a bare index, so you can see what an overlay will sit behind
Runs go one variant at a time: live progress ('Variant 3/5 — rendering video'), After Effects stays responsive between variants, and Cancel stops cleanly after the current variant
Your setup is remembered between sessions, and named setups can be saved and reloaded for recurring formats
Open output folder button next to Run; the Run bar now stays pinned and reachable
Panel redesign: grouped cards, real spacing, and settings that fold away once configured — VAR fits one screen instead of one and a half
Fixed: only the 9x16 still image was being written — saveFrameToPng can return before the file exists, so all four stills now render reliably
Fixed: the position preview sometimes came up blank or showed the previous comp's frame
Fixed: the layer picker could target an imported precomp that shared the studio naming convention instead of the real render comp
Fixed: hex colour fields could not be typed into by hand, only pasted
Fixed: duplicate variant names are now blocked before a run instead of silently overwriting each other, and re-run overwrites are reported
Fixed: crash when adding a still-image logo (timeRemapEnabled), and a logo landing between the badge's own two layers
Fixed: host errors were being swallowed, so failures showed no message at all
Redesign: warm amber palette, fewer boxes, clearer hierarchy
Fixed: Presets panel appeared in the wrong place and could be opened with nothing to apply it to
Release tooling: cross-platform release script
Cross-platform font picker: autocomplete dropdown of real installed PostScript font names for text layers, on both macOS and Windows
Emoji overlay (ITR mode): per-iteration emoji picker, shared position/size/layer-index config, live preview, emoji-only runs with no layer selection required
VAR mode: named-variant iterations with per-layer media replacement, 4 aspect ratios (9x16/1x1/16x9/4x5)
ITR mode gains a 4th aspect ratio, ITR_4x5
Initial BoltCEP rewrite: ITR core — shape/text/stroke/video color and effect iteration, PNG + video rendering, project collection
